_doc: Source-language strings. Flat dotted keys (namespace.name). Placeholders are {name:int} or {name:str}. A plural is an object with 'one' and 'other'. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Run spec/tools/gen_strings.py after any change.
app.name: ScanFit
draft.retain_failed: Could not keep this file for later. You can still save it now.
review.check_fail: {value:str}, does not pass this slot's check
home.title: What would you like to do?
home.fix_file_body: Check a photo, signature or PDF before you upload it.
home.presets_unverified: Spec data could not be verified
exam.live_photo_row: Photo is captured live on the portal
exam.not_found: This exam is no longer in the list.
flow.tip_paper: Use white paper · daylight · no shadow
flow.confirm_handwriting: I signed in running handwriting, not CAPITAL letters
flow.declaration_copy_from_notice: Copy the text from the official notice
match.none: Doesn't match any exam in ScanFit — that's fine for other forms
match.sheet_other_exam: To make a file for another exam, open that exam from Home.
issue.extension_mismatch: The file name and the real file type don't match. Some portals reject this.
issue.cmyk_color: This JPEG uses CMYK colours. Many portals reject it.
issue.progressive_jpeg: This is a progressive JPEG. Some portals reject it.
issue.has_gps_exif: This photo carries your location. We remove it when saving.
issue.rotated_by_exif: This photo is rotated by hidden data. It may appear sideways on the portal.
issue.heic_not_accepted: HEIC files are rejected by most portals. Convert to JPG.
issue.pdf_encrypted: This PDF is password protected. Remove the password first.
issue.wrong_aspect: The shape doesn't match. Crop to the right proportions.
issue.low_dpi_metadata: The DPI setting in the file is not {dpi:int}.
issue.grayscale_not_allowed: Black-and-white (grayscale) files are not accepted here.
export.save_failed: Could not save the file. Please try again.
export.verify_failed: The saved file did not pass verification. Please try again.
export.share_failed: Could not prepare the file to share. Please try again.
export.save_all_partial: Saved {saved:int} of {total:int}. Try again for the rest.
export.save_all_held: Open your signature once to confirm it is in running handwriting, then save it.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.fit_too_detailed: Too detailed to fit in {max_kb:int} KB. Try a plainer background or crop closer.
error.fit_cannot_reach: Couldn't get under {max_kb:int} KB. Try fewer pages or crop the margins.
error.export_verify_failed: The saved file didn't pass our check, so we removed it. Please save again.
error.preset_bad_signature: Spec update rejected: it failed the safety check. Using the last good version.
error.face_none: No face found. Retake the photo with your face clearly visible.
error.face_multiple: More than one face found. Crop to one person.
settings.language_hint: Change the app language in system settings
settings.show_unverified_hint: Also list exams whose upload rules are not confirmed yet
legal.disclaimer: ScanFit is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with any exam body or government. Specs come from official notifications (linked in the app), but always check the current notice before you submit.
checker.title: Check a file
checker.intro: Pick the file you plan to upload. ScanFit checks it against the exam's rules and changes nothing unless you ask.
checker.open_failed: Couldn't open this file. Try another one.
checker.no_issues: No problems with the file itself.
checker.no_fix: ScanFit can't fix this file here. Make a new one from the exam's checklist.
checker.needs_pdf: ScanFit can't make a PDF from this file. If it has a password, remove it first.
checker.original_kept: Your original file is not changed.
home.check_file: Already have a file? Check it.
custom.title: Custom size
custom.intro: For a form that isn't in ScanFit. Copy the limits from its notice.
custom.size_hint: Leave both empty to keep the picture's own size.
custom.error_max_kb_missing: Enter the largest file size the form allows.
custom.error_max_kb_range: Max must be between 1 and 5120 KB.
custom.error_min_kb_range: Min must be less than max.
custom.error_size_pair: Enter both width and height, or leave both empty.
custom.error_width_range: Width must be between 16 and 2000 pixels.
custom.error_height_range: Height must be between 16 and 2000 pixels.
kit.load_failed: Could not load your prepared files. Please try again.
kit.full: My Kit holds 30 originals. Delete one to save this picture.
kit.save_failed: Could not save to My Kit. Please try again.
kit.originals_empty_body: On a review, tap Save to My Kit to keep the picture and use it for other exams.
kit.originals_load_failed: Could not load your originals. Please try again.
kit.original_missing: This original could not be opened, so it was removed from My Kit.
kit.delete_body: Files you already made from it are not affected.
kit.history_empty_body: Files you save appear here. You can share them again for 30 days.
kit.history_load_failed: Could not load your history. Please try again.
kit.history_clear_body: Files stay where you saved them. Only this list and the copies kept for sharing are deleted.
photo.tips: Plain light background · look straight at the camera · no cap or dark glasses
photo.open_failed: Couldn't open this image. Try another photo.
photo.crop_hint: Drag to move · pinch to zoom
photo.crop_tight: Your face fills most of the photo, so the crop is tighter than usual. A photo from further away works better.
photo.strip_hint: This exam may need your name and date on the photo. Check the notice.
photo.white_bg_unavailable: White background isn't available on this device.
ink.source_heading: Photograph it on plain white paper
ink.crop_hint: Drag the corners to leave out everything else
ink.too_faint: The ink looks too faint. Use a darker pen, or retake it in better light.
ink.too_dark: Too much of the image is dark. Use plain white paper and crop closer.
ink.declaration_heading: Write this by hand, sign it, then photograph it
tools.pdf_images_body: Photos of pages, one A4 page each
tools.pdf_compress_body: Get a PDF under the size the form asks for
tools.pdf_id_card_body: Front and back at true size
pdf.intro_images: Add photos of each page. Each one becomes an A4 page.
pdf.intro_compress: Choose a PDF and the size the form allows.
pdf.intro_merge: Add the PDFs in the order you want them.
pdf.intro_id_card: Add the front and the back of the card, then crop each side to the card's edges.
pdf.intro_exam: Add photos of the pages or a PDF you already have. ScanFit makes one PDF that fits.
pdf.grayscale_hint: About half the size. Stamps lose their colour.
pdf.max_kb_hint: Use the limit from the form.
pdf.max_kb_error: Enter a size from 1 to 5120 KB.
pdf.need_two: Add at least two PDFs to merge.
pdf.need_both_sides: Add both sides of the card.
pdf.text_as_image: Text in this PDF is now part of an image. Portals accept this.
pdf.unchanged: This PDF already fits. Nothing was changed.
pdf.padded: The PDF was small, so it was made bigger to reach the minimum. The pages are unchanged.
pdf.error_encrypted: This PDF has a password. Remove the password first.
pdf.error_unreadable: Couldn't open one of the files. Try another one.
pdf.error_too_many: Too many pages. Use at most 20.
pdf.error_cannot_reach: Can't get this under {max:int} KB. Try fewer pages or crop the margins.
pdf.error_unknown_limit: This exam's PDF size isn't verified yet. Check the notice.
pdf.error_failed: Couldn't make the PDF. Please try again.
home.subtitle: Resize photos and signatures, make PDFs, or get every file an exam form asks for.
home.card_exams_body: Every photo, signature and document an exam asks for, made to its rules
home.card_photo_body: Any size in KB, pixels or cm
home.card_signature_body: Clean up and resize a signature on paper
home.card_thumb_body: A clear thumb print at any size
home.card_document_body: Declarations and notes, cleaned up and sized
tools.guide_sheet_body: Print boxes at true size to sign in
tools.coach_body: Practise the live photo a portal takes
kit.preview_failed: Couldn't open this file. It may no longer be kept.
kit.save_preview_title: Save this picture to My Kit?
kit.save_preview_body: ScanFit keeps the whole picture, not the cropped file, so you can use it again for other exams.
infoplist.camera_usage: ScanFit uses the camera to take your photo for exam forms. The photo stays on your phone.
